title: Animal Opposites Playground | Up, Down, In, Out and More for Kids
description:
Explore six opposite pairs in colourful split-screen animal scenes: up/down, in/out, near/far, over/under, open/closed, and day/night. Each pair includes a simple explanation and a five-second movement prompt.

A Tiny Tales vocabulary adventure supporting spatial language, comparison, listening, and whole-body learning for children ages 3 to 7.
